details.headline: Production reliability, platform architecture, and AI UX
details.overview: Lead full-stack delivery across frontend, backend, and operations, including CI/CD ownership with Jenkins and Harness plus production rollout validation through OpenShift Console.

sections.title: Production Reliability & Observability
items: Sustain production reliability through on-call rotations using Datadog logs and traces for root-cause analysis and incident resolution.
Resolved a system-critical deadlock in a core Java component, preventing downtime and stabilizing customer-facing dashboards.
Led architecture refactors toward production-ready standards using metric-driven PBIs to validate reliability and performance gains.

sections.title: Data Platform & Performance
items: Engineered dynamic cascading filters enabling multi-attribute segmentation across dashboards and faster data exploration.
Built an embeddable data insights module and used Redis caching to persist dashboard state across integrated products.
Improved chart rendering performance and user-level customization, contributing to a 22% increase in user retention.

sections.title: AI Features & Workflow Systems
items: Implemented SSE streaming with fetchEventSource to deliver real-time OpenAI chatbot responses with lower perceived latency.
Designed and implemented an AI chatbot interface in React integrated with OpenAI through Java REST services.
Delivered full-stack controls that allowed super-users to disable widget refresh and prevent shared-widget failures.

sections.title: CI/CD, Platform Operations & Collaboration
items: Owned day-to-day CI/CD execution across Jenkins and Harness pipelines, including build orchestration, deployment sequencing, and rollback-ready release flow.
Used OpenShift Console to monitor deployment health, inspect pod/runtime behavior, and validate production rollouts after pipeline runs.
Automated test-and-release stages to reduce manual handoffs and keep delivery cycles fast and repeatable.
Used Docker and GitHub Actions to support rapid CI/CD, automated testing, and controlled releases.
Mentored interns on full-stack fundamentals, code quality, Git workflows, and scalable design patterns.
Collaborated in Agile/SCRUM delivery cycles across engineering and product stakeholders.

details.closing: Delivered measurable reliability and retention gains while scaling full-stack platform capabilities in production.
